dailyHeadline: UNDEFEATED CAAAAM STALKS 12-0 WHILE 3-8 ELORD11 PULLS A 2:13 AM THANKSGIVING HANGOVER TRADE
dailySubhead: Fresh off surviving CarlaCote by 0.36 points, 11-0 Caaaam leads CerealStroke 73.2-61.9 in Week 12 while JewsInParis drops 93.88 early and ELord11 buys back Omarion Hampton from 2-9 owenriddell in the dead of night.
tickerTape: WEEK 12 LIVE: JewsInParis (7-4) explodes to 93.88-35.6 lead over Unanswered (5-6) to snap a 3-game skid
HEARTBREAK IN KINGSTON: Caaaam (11-0) edged CarlaCote (6-5) 145.06-144.7 in Week 11—and now leads CerealStroke 73.2-61.9
2:13 AM TRADE ALERT: ELord11 (3-8) ships Mike Gesicki & Rhamondre Stevenson to owenriddell (2-9) to re-acquire Omarion Hampton
WAIVER COMEDY: JewsInParis drops Makai Lemon ($6 FAAB in W11) & Sam Darnold on 11/25, then spends $1 FAAB on 11/27 to re-add Darnold
TIGHTEST RACE ON ROUTE 138: CarlaCote (54.7) holds narrow early lead over superteam PrayingGrantis (52.04) despite spending just $7 FAAB all year
CEREALSTROKE STREAK: Zero FAAB spent all season, 227.84 bench points wasted, yet riding a 2-game heater after torching ELord11 148.24-129.66

roasts.headline: ELord11's 2:13 AM Trade Addiction Strikes Again—Re-Acquiring Omarion Hampton From 2-9 owenriddell
roasts.body:
Nothing good ever happens on Route 138 after 2:00 AM, and ELord11 just proved it by waking up out of a turkey coma at 2:13:52 AM on Black Friday to swap Mike Gesicki and Rhamondre Stevenson to 2-9 owenriddell for Omarion Hampton. If that name sounds familiar, it's because ELord11 literally traded Omarion Hampton TO owenriddell back in Week 7! That is not roster management; that is a compulsive trade addict renting his own ex-players from the league's basement on an eight-game losing streak.

Meanwhile, the Week 11-12 trade ticker looks like a yard sale at Keaney Gym. Just days after Tylero0 pried Trey McBride away from ELord11 for Jameson Williams and Tucker Kraft, owenriddell flipped DeVonta Smith to JewsInParis for Jordan Love and Jordyn Tyson—immediately after JewsInParis acquired Tyson in a five-player swap with Shipoopiehole involving Travis Kelce, Stefon Diggs, Dalton Kincaid, and Ladd McConkey. Two 3-8 squads and a 2-9 corpse are shuffling deck chairs on the Titanic while Caaaam probably sits on his throne wishing he could veto all of them.

roasts.headline: JewsInParis Detonates For 93.88 Early While Witness-Protection CarlaCote Stalks PrayingGrantis
roasts.body:
After bleeding out through a brutal three-game losing streak—including last week's humiliating 126.36-122.34 loss to Shipoopiehole—7-4 JewsInParis finally woke up and chose violence. Sitting at 93.88 points before Friday morning coffee even finished brewing, JewsInParis is currently burying 5-6 Unanswered (35.6) under the Ryan Center floorboards. Maybe flipping Jordan Love for DeVonta Smith finally exorcised the lingering curse of trading Drake London for Jordan Mason.

Elsewhere in Week 12, witness-protection assassin CarlaCote (6-5) refuses to die quietly. One week after losing an agonizing 145.06-144.7 heartbreaker to undefeated Caaaam, CarlaCote leads PrayingGrantis's 8-3 superteam 54.7 to 52.04 despite having spent only $7 FAAB all season. And speaking of Caaaam, the 11-0 juggernaut leads 73.2-61.9 against 2-9 CerealStroke—who somehow owns a two-game win streak with $0 FAAB spent, proving you don't even have to open the Sleeper app to embarrass ELord11.

roasts.headline: JewsInParis Plays Musical Chairs With Sam Darnold While PrayingGrantis Burns His Final $19 FAAB
roasts.body:
Somebody needs to take the waiver button away from JewsInParis before Kingston's Wi-Fi crashes. On Wednesday, Nov 25, JewsInParis dropped Sam Darnold for free—only to wake up today, Nov 27, and spend $1 FAAB on waivers to claim Sam Darnold right back. That comes immediately after JewsInParis spent $6 FAAB on Makai Lemon in Week 11 just to dump Lemon five days later for Brenton Strange. At $86 FAAB used, every remaining dollar in JewsInParis's budget is clearly being lit on fire for sport.

At least PrayingGrantis spent with a purpose, firing his last $19 FAAB in Week 11 to grab Chris Rodriguez Jr. (hitting $100 FAAB spent) before scooping Josh Cameron for free today, while Tylero0 spent $10 combined on Konata Mumpfield ($6) and Tyler Higbee ($4, dumping Mark Andrews!). Meanwhile, owenriddell is out here dropping Aaron Rodgers and Xavier Legette to stream the Washington Commanders defense at 2-9, which feels like putting fresh racing stripes on a totaled Honda Civic.

roasts.headline: Caaaam Eyes Perfection At 11-0 While Five Managers Fight For Air Behind The Top Three
roasts.body:
At 11-0 with a league-best 1655.22 points for and a league-low 1370.26 points against, Caaaam is treating Rhody like a tutorial mode. Even when Caaaam blew $50 FAAB on a defense in Week 1 and leaves 224.1 points rotting on the bench, the fantasy gods still hand him a 0.36-point miracle escape over CarlaCote in Week 11. Right behind him, 8-3 PrayingGrantis (1652.02 PF, despite a league-worst 242.52 bench points left behind) and 8-3 Tylero0 (1623.32 PF) are locked in a heavyweight battle for the two-seed bye.

The real bloodbath is for the remaining playoff spots. JewsInParis (7-4) has 1572.5 points for but a brutal 1541.1 points against, while CarlaCote (6-5, 1519.52 PF) is quietly cruising toward the postseason without bothering to use the waiver wire. Below them, 5-6 Unanswered is hanging on by a thread after dropping two straight, while 3-8 ELord11 (6L), 3-8 Shipoopiehole (1630.94 PA!), 2-9 owenriddell (8L), and 2-9 CerealStroke are strictly playing spoiler—and giving the desk daily comedy.

powerRankings.blurb: Still undefeated at 11-0 with a league-high 1655.22 points for and a charmed 1370.26 points against, Caaaam somehow escaped CarlaCote 145.06-144.7 in Week 11 despite blowing $100 FAAB and leaving 224.1 points on his bench. He already leads CerealStroke 73.2-61.9 in Week 12, meaning another smug league newsletter is practically guaranteed.

Sitting at 8-3 on a three-game win streak with 1652.02 points for—just 3.2 behind Caaaam—this superteam could be unbeatable if PrayingGrantis stopped leaving a league-worst 242.52 points on his bench. He spent his final $19 FAAB on Chris Rodriguez Jr. and trails CarlaCote 54.7-52.04 early in Week 12.

Coming off a 147.84-81.78 obliteration of owenriddell, 8-3 Tylero0 sits third in scoring (1623.32 PF) and just fleeced ELord11 yet again to land Trey McBride while dumping Mark Andrews for Tyler Higbee. Up 57.74-44.02 on ELord11 in Week 12, Tylero0 looks primed to cruise.

A three-game losing streak and a 1541.1 points-against nightmare had 7-4 JewsInParis sweating, especially while dropping and re-bidding $1 FAAB on Sam Darnold in the same 48-hour span. Thankfully, adding DeVonta Smith helped fuel a massive 93.88-35.6 early Week 12 lead over Unanswered.

Only CarlaCote could remain in witness protection with just $7 FAAB spent all year, lose 145.06-144.7 to an 11-0 juggernaut, and still sit comfortably at 6-5 with 1519.52 points for. Leading PrayingGrantis 54.7-52.04 in Week 12, CarlaCote remains the league's scariest silent killer.

Sitting at 5-6 on a two-game skid with 1403 points for and $0 FAAB remaining, Unanswered just dropped Bryce Young and immediately walked into a 93.88-35.6 Thanksgiving buzzsaw against JewsInParis. Unless his remaining starters go nuclear, the playoff bubble is about to pop.

Nobody in Rhody has suffered worse schedule luck than 3-8 Shipoopiehole (league-high 1630.94 points against), yet he's riding a two-game win streak after clipping JewsInParis 126.36-122.34 and trading for Travis Kelce and Stefon Diggs. Leading owenriddell 38.8-25.12 early, a three-peat is very much alive.

Owner of a brutal six-game losing streak at 3-8 despite scoring 1418.96 points, ELord11 is feeding his trade addiction by trading Trey McBride to Tylero0 and waking up at 2:13 AM to buy back Omarion Hampton from owenriddell. Currently trailing Tylero0 57.74-44.02, another L is loading.

Wait—check the pulse on 2-9 CerealStroke, who still refuses to spend a single dollar of FAAB ($0 used) and leaves 227.84 points on his bench, yet somehow owns a two-game winning streak after hanging 148.24 on ELord11. Even trailing Caaaam 73.2-61.9, this 1205.04-PF zombie is pure chaos.

Eight straight losses, a 2-9 record, 1236.96 points for, and an 81.78-point beatdown from Tylero0 have officially broken owenriddell's spirit. Dumping Aaron Rodgers for the Commanders defense and trailing Shipoopiehole 38.8-25.12 after trading away DeVonta Smith and Omarion Hampton locks in the cellar.

tradeGrades.summary: owenriddell received Mike Gesicki (TE - CIN) and Rhamondre Stevenson (RB - NE); ELord11 received Omarion Hampton (RB - LAC)
tradeGrades.verdict: Getting the best upside piece in Omarion Hampton for Mike Gesicki and Rhamondre Stevenson at 2:13 AM is actually decent value for ELord11—even if it's hilarious that he had to trade back for a guy he originally shipped to owenriddell in Week 7.

tradeGrades.summary: owenriddell received Jordan Love (QB - GB) and Jordyn Tyson (WR - NO); JewsInParis received DeVonta Smith (WR - PHI)
tradeGrades.verdict: JewsInParis flipped a disposable QB and a throw-in receiver he acquired one day earlier for DeVonta Smith just in time for a 93.88-point Week 12 eruption. Meanwhile, 2-9 owenriddell gave up a legit starting WR for Jordan Love while on an eight-game skid.

tradeGrades.summary: Tylero0 received Trey McBride (TE - ARI); ELord11 received Jameson Williams (WR - DET) and Tucker Kraft (TE - GB)
tradeGrades.verdict: Tylero0 somehow keeps getting away with highway robbery against ELord11, upgrading to an elite positional advantage at tight end with Trey McBride for a boom-bust WR and Tucker Kraft. ELord11's six-game losing streak makes a whole lot more sense.

tradeGrades.summary: Shipoopiehole received Travis Kelce (TE - KC) and Stefon Diggs (WR - WAS); JewsInParis received Dalton Kincaid (TE - BUF), Ladd McConkey (WR - LAC), and Jordyn Tyson (WR - NO)
tradeGrades.verdict: JewsInParis got younger, got the best wideout in Ladd McConkey, and used Jordyn Tyson 24 hours later to pry DeVonta Smith away from owenriddell. Shipoopiehole gets veteran name value in Kelce and Diggs to fuel a 3-8 spoiler run.
